title: OpenAI puts Stargate UK on ice, blames energy costs and red tape
summary: OpenAI宣布暂停英国Stargate数据中心项目，理由是能源成本过高和监管障碍。该项目原计划投资310亿英镑，是OpenAI全球基础设施布局的关键一环。此举反映出AI巨头在扩张过程中面临的能源与政策挑战，可能影响欧洲AI算力部署节奏。

title: SPPO: Sequence-Level PPO for Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
raw_excerpt:
作者: Tianyi Wang, Yixia Li, Long Li, Yibiao Chen, Shaohan Huang, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
摘要: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) in reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. However, standard token-level PPO struggles in this setting due to the instability of temporal credit assignment over long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) horizons and the prohibitive memory cost of the value model. While critic-free alternatives like GRPO mitigate these issues, they incur significant computational overhead by requiring multiple samples for baseline estimation, severely limiting training throughput. In this paper, we introduce Sequence-Level PPO (SPPO), a scalable algorithm that harmonizes the sample efficiency of PPO with the stability of outcome-based updates. SPPO reformulates the reasoning process as a Sequence-Level Contextual Bandit problem, employing a decoupled scalar value function to derive low-variance advantage signals without multi-sampling. Extensive experiments on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that SPPO significantly surpasses standard PPO and matches the performance of computation-heavy group-based methods, offering a resource-efficient framework for aligning reasoning LLMs.
summary: 论文提出SPPO（序列级PPO）方法，用于长链推理任务的对齐训练。针对标准PPO在长思维链中时间信用分配不稳定和价值模型内存开销大的问题，SPPO在序列级别进行优化，无需价值模型，显著降低计算开销。在数学推理等任务上表现优于GRPO等基线。

title: EFF is leaving X
summary: 电子前哨基金会（EFF）宣布正式退出X平台（原Twitter），原因是平台内容审核政策变化与价值观冲突。EFF是数字权利领域最具影响力的非营利组织之一，其退出行为可能引发更多科技组织重新评估在X上的存在，对平台生态产生连锁影响。

title: We've raised $17M to build what comes after Git
summary: GitButler宣布获得1700万美元A轮融资，用于构建“Git之后”的下一代版本控制系统。该公司由Git核心贡献者创建，旨在解决Git在大型项目协作中的痛点。此轮融资由知名风投领投，表明开发者工具领域对新一代版本控制系统的强烈需求。

title: The Vercel plugin on Claude Code wants to read your prompts
summary: 开发者发现Vercel为Claude Code开发的插件会读取用户的提示词（prompts）并发送至远程服务器。该行为未在文档中明确说明，引发隐私担忧。此事件凸显了AI开发工具生态中数据透明性的重要性，以及第三方插件可能带来的安全风险。

title: Reverse engineering Gemini's SynthID detection
summary: 开发者成功逆向工程了Google Gemini的AI水印系统SynthID，并在GitHub上公开了技术细节。SynthID用于在AI生成图像中嵌入不可见水印，此次逆向工程揭示了其工作原理，可能影响AI内容溯源技术的可靠性，对AI生成内容的认证与监管具有重要参考价值。

title: Opus as an Advisor with Sonnet
summary: Anthropic发布“顾问策略”（Advisor Strategy），将Opus模型作为高级顾问与Sonnet模型协同工作，提升复杂任务的处理质量。该策略通过让Opus提供指导性建议，再由Sonnet执行，在编程、分析等场景中取得更好效果。这为多模型协作提供了新的实用范式。

title: Show HN: SmolVM – open-source sandbox for coding and computer-use agents
raw_excerpt:
SmolVM is an open-source local sandbox for AI agents on macOS and Linux.

I started building it because agent workflows need more than isolated code execution. They need a reusable environment: write files in one step, come back later, snapshot state, pause/resume, and increasingly interact with browsers or full desktop environments.

Right now SmolVM is a Python SDK and CLI focused on local developer experience.

Current features include: - local sandbox environments - macOS and Linux support - snapshotting - pause/resume - persistent environments across turns

Install: ``` curl -sSL https://celesto.ai/install.sh | bash smolvm ```

summary: CelestoAI开源SmolVM，一个面向AI代理的本地沙箱环境，支持macOS和Linux。它提供代码执行、快照、暂停/恢复、持久化环境等功能，专为需要浏览器或桌面交互的代理工作流设计。作为开源替代方案，有助于降低AI代理开发的门槛。

title: Show HN: QVAC SDK, a universal JavaScript SDK for building local AI applications
raw_excerpt:
Hi folks, today we're launching QVAC SDK [0], a universal JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for building local AI applications across desktop and mobile.

The project is fully open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Our goal is to make it easier for developers to build useful local-first AI apps without having to stitch together a lot of different engines, runtimes, and platform-specific integrations. Under the hood, the SDK is built on top of QVAC Fabric [1], our cross-platform inference and fine-tuning engine.

QVAC SDK uses Bare [2], a lightweight cross-platform JavaScript runtime that is part of the Pear ecosystem [3]. It can be used as a worker pretty much anywhere, with built-in tooling for Node, Bun and React Native (Hermes).

summary: QVAC SDK发布，一个通用的JavaScript/TypeScript SDK，用于构建本地AI应用。它基于QVAC Fabric跨平台推理引擎，支持桌面和移动端，完全开源（Apache 2.0）。开发者无需拼接多个引擎即可快速构建本地优先的AI应用，降低了本地AI开发复杂度。

title: A complete GPT language model in ~600 lines of C#, zero dependencies
summary: 开发者用约600行C#代码实现了一个完整的GPT语言模型，零外部依赖。该项目展示了从零构建Transformer的核心逻辑，包括注意力机制、前馈网络等，对于理解LLM底层原理具有教学价值，也体现了现代语言模型在小型设备上运行的潜力。
